name: Chitose
source: A girl who puts the "mystery" in "mysterious." She's naive, pure, and a free spirit. Who knows what she gets up to on a daily basis? She calls herself a magical girl and often bursts out into unladylike guffaws. In other words, she's as weird as they come.
